lines_en: A house viewing gives you thirty minutes.
The decision stays with you for years.
I'm Halo. My partner and I are looking for our first home.
How long is the walk home at night? Is the morning train full? What does a month really cost?
I could look at a home for thirty minutes. I couldn't live in it before I signed.

scenes.caption_en: Korea's riskiest decision falls on the youngest.
rows_en: About {stat:jeonse_fraud_victims_2030_pct}% of deposit-fraud victims are in their 20s and 30s

scenes.caption_en: Before you sign, an AI household lives 30 days in each home.
Korea first: a couple working in Pangyo says it in plain words. Muse Spark calls real tools.

callouts.text_en: Prices = median of real purchase deals, in full won

scenes.caption_en: Pick two. The same household lives the same month in both homes.
Every trip, minute by minute, in a 3D model of the real neighbourhood.
What the listing doesn't say: 7 min vs 24 min to work; walking home after dark 10 vs 36 times a month.

callouts.text_en: Example listing text: “5 min to the station”
After living it: 7 min vs 24 min one-way

scenes.caption_en: Ithaca never picks for you. It shows you, and you decide.
Code re-checks every number; a separate Muse judge rejects unsupported sentences.

callouts.text_en: Report check: passed on the first try
